title: Realtime update and other misc updates

body.text: This section has been added as an announcement on the site, but I'm including it here as well since it's pretty important. The rest of the smaller updates are listed at the bottom.

A real-time server component has been added to the site. This allows me to add features where users can interact with each other live. The first is a chat widget in the bottom-right corner of the site. Currently it only has a Global Chat where anyone can talk or ask for help with the site, but I'm also working on other real-time features, like multiplayer support for the Guessers and collaborative editing for Builds and MD Plans, which will also have their own chat rooms. These are opt-in features so they won't affect site performance or use extra data unless you use them. I'm still figuring things out so you may run into some issues and the chat may briefly disconnect when I'm deploying updates.

Last month, the site came very close to reaching the point where I'd need to upgrade my hosting plan. Because of that, I need to start thinking more seriously about the financial side of the site. Based on the results of the previous site survey, I plan to introduce ads some time later this month. I'll keep them minimal and unobtrusive, so they won't affect the site experience, but if you'd rather not see them, you can disable them in Site Customization.

texts: Removed the Random Tips section on the homepage since it didn't seem too useful.
Added a company filter to the Identities page, the E.G.Os page, and to advanced filter options on the pages that use it.
Fixed gifticons token type not autocompleting properly. Also changed it to automatically insert the colon separator.
Fixed extraction simulator sometimes pulling event reward ids into the pool.
Adjusted the positioning of the emotes/stickers popup picker.
Adjusted the colored borders on the Builds and MD Plans so they more properly cover the default border.
Fixed a hidden error that sometimes occured in the markdown editor.
